title: 放学蹦蹦跳
designIntent: 用短促跳跃的动机与轻快弹跳的律动，描绘放学后与朋友一起玩耍的开心场景。
moodSummary: 放学后，和朋友一起玩，开心。

melodyProfile.phraseBreath: two-bar single phrase with mid-phrase rest
melodyProfile.repetitionStrategy: motif stated twice with slight rhythmic variation and connecting leap

arrangement.keyboardRole: sole foreground melody, staccato bounce articulation
arrangement.bassRole: root notes on beats 1 and 3, quarter-note pulse with slight ghost on off-beats
arrangement.drumRole: kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4, closed hi-hat eighth notes for body bounce

likelyConflicts: Keyboard staccato motif on beat 2.5 may clash with sax long tone sustaining through beat 2-3
Bass quarter-note pulse on beat 5 could overlap with sax second long tone entry
resolutions: Sax long tone on degree 3 is voiced an octave below keyboard and played at pp dynamic, avoiding frequency masking
Bass plays root note only on beats 1 and 3, rests on beat 5 first half; sax enters beat 5 alone before bass resumes on beat 7

moodInput: 放学后，和朋友一起玩，开心。
